comments.content: This EOF check assumes the remote validator uses the exact same pagination limit as this client. The limit is not part of the query or response, so a mixed-version validator with a smaller limit (especially once the TODO changes this value) will return a short, nonempty page and the client will silently omit the remaining log. Continue until an empty page is returned, or add an explicit continuation/total-count marker to the protocol.
